Anya (Product): Quick check-in on audit retention + BYOK export. Proposal: add retention_tier, data_class, evidence_digest, optional kms_key_ref to every audit event. Need decisions on strictness, backfill, and SOC2 launch gates.

Devon (Infra): Prefer enrichment worker + `enriched_v1` flag instead of re-ingest. Backfill window 48-72h. Map retention_tier -> billing_label for cost.

Samira (Security): evidence_digest = sha256(canonical_payload [+ kms_key_ref salt]). Require export attestation (grant id, timestamp). Legal hold overrides retention_tier.

Matt R (Eng): Ingest validation: strict for required fields (tenant_id,evidence_digest,retention_tier), lenient for extras. Add quarantine metric for rejects.

Anya (Product): Launch gates: schema v1 validation, console retention view, BYOK export with attestation, SOC2 runbook signed. Owners: Anya(prod), Matt(schema/API), Devon(enrichment/backfill), Samira(security/runbook). ops-bot: create RFC stub pls.

ops-bot: RFC stub created: https://docs.internal/rfcs/audit-retention-byo (created by Anya) :white_check_mark:
